remarks_1999: Back: A.S.: '1915–1916.' Shown: Photo Sucession Gallery, ~~1915~~ 1916? {'1915' crossed out} . . .Note: Date of painting in doubt. 'Not recorded Whitney Archive. O'Keeffe wrote: '*Drawing No. 9* is the drawing of a headache. It was a very bad headache at the time that I was busy drawing every night, sitting on the floor in front of the closet door'(*Some Memories of Drawings* [1988], unpaginated). Titled *Special No. 9* by O'Keeffe on Abiquiú Notebooks photograph. Pictured in 1923 New York (Anderson) Stieglitz installation photograph, see Appendix III, figure 18. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: No. 9 Special

description: Several undulating black lines run diagonally from the bottom left to the center-right edge of the composition. Running parallel to these lines is a strip of dark gray punctuated by small black rectangles. Light gray, billowing forms dominate the upper half of the composition, punctuated by soft, darker gray shapes that resemble drops of water.
title: No. 9 Special
